settings.title: Can I switch plans at any time?

settings.editor: Yes, you can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription whenever you wish directly from your account settings.

settings.title: Is there a free trial available?

settings.editor: All paid plans come with a 14-day free trial. No credit card is required to begin testing.
We accept all major credit cards including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, as well as PayPal and wire transfers.
